home.title: Welcome to Ardoise
home.body: Pages, databases and real-time collaboration will appear here as they are built.

login.title: Sign in

setup.title: Set up Ardoise

setup.missingToken: Open the setup link printed in the server logs to continue. It contains a one-time code.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email, a reset link is on its way. It is valid for one hour. If nothing arrives, ask your administrator.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. You can now sign in.
